day_local: Xuska Quduus Leo oo Weyn, Baadari iyo Dhakhtarka Kaniisadda
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix, jacaylka Ilaaha Aabbaha ah, iyo wada-jirka Ruuxa Quduuska ah ha idinla jiraan.
penitential: Rabbiyow, naxariiso. Masiixow, naxariiso. Rabbiyow, naxariiso.
psalm_response: Badbaadada kuwa xaqa ah waxay ka timaadaa Rabbiga.
homily:
Bal ka fikir subax qabow, marka aad guriga ka baxayso, oo aad aragto qof yar oo si taxaddar leh u xiranaya kabahiisa, isagoo diyaar u ah inuu maalinta wajaho. Waxaa jira xasilooni ku jirta qofka garanaya waxa uu qabanayo, qofka aan u baahnayn in la amro ama la riixo, balse si fudud u guta hawshiisa maalinlaha ah. Injiilka maanta, Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa sheeko u muuqata mid adag—sheekada addoonka soo shaqeeyay ee weli u adeegaya sayidkiisa. Waxaynu u barannay inaynu u aragno 'adeegidda' inay tahay wax lagu abaalmariyo, laakiin Ciise wuxuu inoo sheegayaa inaan nahay 'addoommo aan faa'iido lahayn,' oo aynu samaynay waxa aynu waajib ku nahay inaan samayno. Waa halkaas meesha ay ka bilaabato xornimada dhabta ah.

Waxaan maanta ka fikireynaa Benjamin Vo. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil fahmay xikmad aan dad badan oo waaweyn aysan fahmin. Waxaad ogtihiin inuu ahaa wiil maskaxdiisu ay ku dhex noolayd dunida tiknoolajiyadda, koodhka, DevOps, iyo riyada ah inuu abuuro 'con chim airlines'—shirkaddaas yar ee uu mar walba qosol iyo dhoola caddayn ku xasuusin jiray markii uu ka sheekaynayey. Laakiin maanta, ma doonayo inaan ka hadlo kaliya diyaaradihiisa. Waxaan rabaa inaan idin xasuusiyo qalbigiisa. Xusuusnow markii uu ahaa 15 jir, ee uu u sheegay hooyadiis iyo aabbihiis inuu diyaar u yahay inuu dhiibo sanduuqiisa lacagta ku jirtay si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanaa? Ma uusan jebin sanduuqaydiisa, mana loo baahnayn in la jebiyo, lacagtiisana lama bixin sababtoo ah waxaa jiray caymis, laakiin dalabkaas saafi ah—wiil yar oo unprompted ah oo doonayay inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto si uu qof u caawiyo—waa muraayadda jacaylka saafi ah ee Masiixu inaga raba. Ben wuxuu ahaa addoonka Rabbiga ee faraxsan, kan aan sugin abaalmarin, balse si fudud u bixiyay wax kasta oo uu haystay.

Alan iyo Thao, waan ogahay in afartan bilood ay yihiin kuwo culus. Waxaan rabaa inaan si daacad ah idiinla hadlo maanta. Waxaa jira saacado marka aad guriga dhexdiisa dareemaysaan in booska Ben uu yahay mid aan marnaba buuxsami karin, marka aad aragtaan kabaha uu bananka soo dhigay ama aad maqashaan dhawaaq u eg kii uu sameyn jiray. Waxaa laga yaabaa inay jiraan waqtiyo aad naftiina ku eedaysaan, ama aad is weydiisataan haddii aad wax ka qaban karteen, haddii ay jirtay meel aad ka gaabiseen. Fadlan, halkan ku hakada. Maanta, kelmadda Ilaah waxay ku leedahay qalbigaaga: Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Sida Ciise uu u sheegay kuwii weydiiyey cidda dembaabtay ee wiilka indhaha la' dhalay, 'Neither this man nor his parents.' Xanuunka noocan ah waa mid ka baxsan awoodda bini'aadamka, mana jiro qof masuul ka ah. Waxaad ahaydeen waalid qumman, jacaylkiinnuna waa kan weli Ben la socda. Ha is-eedeynin; Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu ku jiraa gacmaha Aabbaha oo aanay jirin wax dhib ah. Waxaad dareemi kartaa xorriyadda inaad baroorato adigoon dareemin dambi, waayo jacaylkaaga ayaa ahaa kan ugu weyn.

Bawlos, akhriska koowaad ee maanta, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa in 'nimcada Ilaah ay u muuqatay badbaadinta dadka oo dhan.' Nimcadaasi ma aha mid ku xiran waxa aynu qabanno, balse waa mid ku xiran waxa uu Ilaah inoo qabtay. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil nimcadaas ku dhex noolaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiilka ku yiri Aabbihiis riyadii uu ku arkay: 'Baaba, test nào con cũng qua hết.' Haa, Ben wuu gudbay, wuxuuna hadda joogaa meel uu nabad ku helo. Wuxuu hadda ka mid yahay kuwa Bawlos ka hadlayo, kuwaas oo sugaya 'muuqaalka ammaanta Ilaah.'

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, adiga oo maanta halkan jooga, oo xasuusanaya xiriirka adiga iyo Ben idin ka dhaxeeyay, ogow inuusan Ben kaa fogayn. Wuxuu weli ku jiraa qalbigaaga. Ha ka baqina inaad nolosha horay u qaadaan, inaad ku raaxaysataan waxyaabaha yaryar ee quruxda badan, sababtoo ah Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdaan. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu xasuusan jiray markii ay wada ciyaarayeen ama ay wada safrayeen. Jacaylkaagu waa mid sii socon doona oo aan dhamaanayn.

Sidee buu kanu hadda u taabanayaa qof kasta oo naga mid ah oo maanta halkan jooga? Adiga oo hooyo ah oo habeenkii ilmaynaysa, adiga oo aabbe ah oo xasuusanaya sheekooyinka uu Ben si dhab ah u dhagaysan jiray, adiga oo ah qof dareemaya inuu culaysku ka batay—ogow in Rabbigu uu kula socdo. Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ka helay irridda xigmadda iyo nabadda Jannada, halkaas oo aanay jirin ilmeyn ama daal. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in iimaankaagu uusan dhammaan doonin, maxaa yeelay Ilaah waa kan ku siinaya xoog maalin kasta. Waxaad tahay mid qaali ah. Waxaad tahay mid la jecel yahay. Ben wuxuu idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay weligiis. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciisow, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramental-ka Quduuska ah. Waxaan ku jecelahay wax kasta, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin si sacramental ah, fadlan igu soo gal ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan ku soo dhaweynayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana isku xirayaa naftayda adiga gebi ahaanba. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin dhawro, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna qaaliga ah ee Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii naga horreeyay ee dhintay, in Rabbigu siiyo nasasho iyo iftiin weligeed ah.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa xanuunka la ildaran, in Ilaah uu ku xoojiyo rajo, nabad, iyo jacaylkiisa aan dhammaadka lahayn.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Gacaliye: Waa inaad sheegtaa waxa waafaqsan cilmiga dhawaaqa leh, kuwaas oo ah in ragga waayeelka ah ay ahaadaan kuwa dhexdhexaad ah, sharaf leh, is-xakameynaya, iimaan, jacayl iyo dulqaad ku leh. Sidoo kale, haweenka waayeelka ah waa inay ahaadaan kuwa xushmad leh oo ay u dhaqmaan, aan xaman, aan khamri ku xad-gudbin, baraya waxa wanaagsan, si ay u tababaraan haweenka da'da yar inay jeclaadaan raggooda iyo carruurtooda, inay ahaadaan kuwo is-xakameynaya, nadiif ah, guri-daryeelayaal wanaagsan, oo hoos imanaya raggooda, si aan ereyga Ilaah loo ceebayn. Sidoo kale, ku dhiiri geli ragga da'da yar inay is-xakameeyaan, adigoo naftaada u muujinaya qaab-dhismeedka camal wanaagsan oo dhan, adigoo daacadnimo ku leh waxbariddaada, sharaf leh, oo leh hadal wanaagsan oo aan la dhaliili karin, si cadowga loo ceeboobo iyadoo aanay wax xun ka sheegi karin. Waayo, nimcada Ilaah ayaa u muuqatay, iyadoo badbaadinaysa dadka oo dhan, oo ina tababartay inaynu diidno dariiqooyinka aan Ilaah ka cabsanayn iyo rabitaanka adduunka, oo aynu u noolaanno si dhexdhexaad ah, si cadaalad ah, iyo si cibaado leh xilligan, inta aynu sugayno rajada barakaysan, muuqaalka ammaanta Ilaaha weyn iyo Badbaadiyeheenna Ciise Masiix, kaas oo naftiisa u bixiyay si uu inaga badbaadiyo xumaan kasta oo uu u nadiifiyo dad u gaar ah naftiisa, kuwaas oo u heellan inay sameeyaan waxa wanaagsan.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. Badbaadada kuwa xaqa ah waxay ka timaadaa Rabbiga. Rabbiga aamin oo wanaag samee, si aad dhulka u degto oo aad nabad u hesho. Rabbiga ku raaxayso, oo wuxuu ku siin doonaa codsiyada qalbigaaga. R. Badbaadada kuwa xaqa ah waxay ka timaadaa Rabbiga. Rabbigu wuxuu ilaaliyaa nolosha kuwa qalbiga daacadda ah; dhaxalkoodu wuu sii jiri doonaa weligiis. Rabbiga ayaa tallaabooyinka nin ka dhiga mid adag, oo wuxuu oggolaadaa jidkiisa. R. Badbaadada kuwa xaqa ah waxay ka timaadaa Rabbiga. Xumaanta ka leexo oo wanaag samee, si aad weligaa u sii jirto; kuwa xaqa ah ayaa dhulka hanti u yeelan doona oo degganaan doona weligood. R. Badbaadada kuwa xaqa ah waxay ka timaadaa Rabbiga.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Ciise wuxuu Rasuulladii ku yidhi: “Kumaa idin ah oo ku odhan lahaa addoonkiisa oo hadda uun ka yimid qodista ama adhiga oo beer ku soo daaqay, ‘Halkan u kaalay oo miiska fadhiiso’? Muxuu halkii ka odhan lahaa, ‘Ii diyaari waxaan cunaa. Xidho maradaada oo ii adeeg intaan wax cunayo oo cabbayo. Adiguna waad cuni kartaa oo cabbi kartaa markaan dhammeeyo’? Miyaanu u mahadnaqayn addoonkaas maxaa yeelay wuxuu sameeyay wixii lagu amray? Sidaas oo kale ha ahaato idinkana. Markaad samaysaan wax kasta oo laydin amray, waxaad tidhaahdaan, ‘Waxaan nahay addoommo aan faa'iido lahayn; waxaannu samaynay wixii nalagu waajibiyay.’”

day: Memorial of Saint Leo the Great, Pope and Doctor of the Church

pet_prayers.text: Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!
